title: 2025香港借遮地圖
note:
備註：
1. 原本146間商場站點，包括在官網聲稱有相關服務者，後來經進一步致電及親訪查證，已將當中已取消服務的54間商場剔除，現只紀錄了92間可借遮商場。
2. 順豐速運服務網點的借傘活動，亦將會在2025年尾結束。

相關文章：【借遮地圖】大雨滂沱尚有甚麼「雨傘共享」的地方？
noteEn: Notes: 1. Out of the original 146 shopping mall locations (including those claiming to offer the service on their official websites), 54 malls that have discontinued the service were removed after phone calls and in-person verification, leaving 92 recorded malls where umbrellas can be borrowed. 2. The umbrella lending campaign at SF Express service outlets will also end in late 2025. Related article: [Umbrella Borrowing Map] Where else can you find umbrella sharing during heavy rain?
excluded: SF Express (順豐) points – the source notes that service ended at the end of 2025; malls marked as cancelled

stations.name: Jie Yeah 借嘢
stations.address: 1B G/F, 1 Lime St, Tai Kok Tsui
stations.service: 手機登記填寫googleForm並提交，就成功借遮。借用後可於到任何一間「借遮點」小店歸還。
stations.terms:
1. Scan 遮架上嘅QR code，填寫google form，並會自動成為「借嘢」嘅會員星期一：10:00-19:00
2.提交google form後，就成功借咗遮喇，之後會收到「借嘢」嘅WhatsApp，內有借用日期及歸還日期
3.每把遮可以借10日，每人最多借1把，借用人可以去任何一間小店還遮，(需根據各小店嘅開放時間)，歸還後可以影相send翻比「借嘢」WhatsApp作紀錄。
營業時間：
星期一,二,四：10:00-19:00 ,星期三,五：13:00-21:00
用膳時間暫停開放:
午膳（星期一、二、四）: 13:30 - 14:30
晚飯（星期三、五）: 18:30 - 19:30
stations.serviceEn: Register via mobile by filling out and submitting the Google Form to successfully borrow an umbrella. After borrowing, you can return it to any "Jie Yeah" partner shop.
stations.termsEn:
1. Scan the QR code on the umbrella rack and fill out the Google form to automatically become a "Jie Yeah" member. Monday: 10:00-19:00
2. After submitting the Google form, you have successfully borrowed an umbrella and will receive a WhatsApp message from "Jie Yeah" containing the borrowing and return dates.
3. Each umbrella can be borrowed for 10 days, with a maximum of 1 umbrella per person. Borrowers can return the umbrella to any partner shop (subject to each shop's opening hours). After returning, take a photo and send it back to the "Jie Yeah" WhatsApp for record.
Opening Hours:
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday: 10:00-19:00, Wednesday, Friday: 13:00-21:00
Suspended during meal times:
Lunch (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday): 13:30 - 14:30
Dinner (Wednesday, Friday): 18:30 - 19:30
